findings.finding: GesturePriority ignores the second contact whenever any contact exists, including when the first contact is still Pending. Frozen Authority requires Pending plus second compatible contact to form a viewport gesture.
The evidence claims invalid terminal ordering is rejected, but no oracle covers it and an Up or Cancel for an unknown PointerKey returns Ignored.
The evidence claims injected claim-conflict coverage, but the coordinator exposes no conflict path and the test contains no atomic failure oracle.
viewportClaimed remains latched after the viewport cohort terminates, so a later cohort cannot establish another viewport claim without a global reset.
